计算流程、参数设置与判定规则: Computational workflow, parameter settings and decision rules
蛋白结构来自 RCSB PDB 或本地 PDB/PDBQT 文件。流程默认去除结: Protein structures were taken from RCSB PDB or from local PDB/PDBQT files. By default the workflow removes crystallographic waters, non-coordinating heteroatoms and alternate conformations (altloc A is retained) and keeps the user-specified chain; hydrogens are added using a template charge model, after which Meeko generates PDBQT files readable by AutoDock Vina. The binding box is derived automatically from the geometric centre and dimensions of the co-crystal ligand, or can be defined by the built-in geometric pocket prediction or by manual coordinates, with a warning issued about the box volume.
配体支持 SMILES、SDF、MOL、MOL2、PDB 与现成 PDBQT。R: Ligands may be supplied as SMILES, SDF, MOL, MOL2, PDB or ready-made PDBQT. RDKit normalises and desalts the structures and protonates them according to pH 7.4 rules (carboxylic acids deprotonated, aliphatic amines protonated); ETKDGv3 generates three-dimensional conformers, MMFF94 performs energy minimisation, and the structures are finally converted to PDBQT.
对接引擎为 AutoDock Vina 1.2.5（CPU），可选 Vina-G: Docking was performed with AutoDock Vina 1.2.5 (CPU), with Vina-GPU 2.0 as an option. In GPU mode, several independent random seeds are searched in parallel and the best pose is re-scored with CPU Vina under the same scoring function, so that CPU and GPU results are directly comparable. Default settings were exhaustiveness = 8, num_modes = 9 and energy_range = 3.0 kcal/mol.
GPU 模式对每个配体执行多次独立复算并用 CPU 复核，吞吐优势只在大批量（约: In GPU mode each ligand is recalculated several times independently and verified on the CPU; the throughput advantage only emerges for large batches (approximately 50 ligands or more), whereas CPU mode is usually faster for small numbers of ligands. Vina-GPU does not use exhaustiveness, and its search intensity is controlled by search_depth; the two settings must be recorded separately in the report.
每个构象同时计算 Vina 与 Vinardo 两套经验打分，并以两项排名之和构: Vina and Vinardo empirical scores were calculated for every pose, and a consensus ranking was formed from the sum of the two ranks; ligand efficiency, LE = −ΔG / number of heavy atoms, was also reported to remove the systematic bias introduced by molecular size.
基于原子间距离与几何判据识别氢键（供体–受体距离 ≤ 3.5 Å 且角度合理）、: Hydrogen bonds (donor–acceptor distance ≤ 3.5 Å with a reasonable angle), hydrophobic contacts (carbon–carbon distance ≤ 4.5 Å), salt bridges (oppositely charged groups ≤ 4.0 Å), π-stacking (centroid distance between aromatic rings ≤ 5.5 Å), halogen bonds and metal coordination were identified from interatomic distances and geometric criteria. Contact types and shortest distances were tallied per residue to construct a protein–ligand interaction fingerprint.
以 12-6 Lennard-Jones 势、Coulomb 静电（ε = 4）: A 12-6 Lennard-Jones potential, Coulomb electrostatics (ε = 4), a Born desolvation term and a geometric hydrogen-bond term were accumulated per residue to yield van der Waals, electrostatic, desolvation and hydrogen-bond contributions together with the total energy. The absolute values are approximate, but the residue ranking and relative comparisons between similar molecules remain informative.
RDKit 描述符计算分子量、cLogP、TPSA、氢键供体/受体、可旋转键、芳: RDKit descriptors were used to compute molecular weight, cLogP, TPSA, hydrogen-bond donors/acceptors, rotatable bonds, aromatic proportion and Fsp3; ESOL was used to estimate aqueous solubility and QED for overall drug-likeness; Lipinski, Veber, Egan and lead-like rules were assessed item by item. Efficiency metrics included LE, LipE, BEI and SEI.
使用 RDKit 基础特征定义识别氢键供体/受体、芳环、疏水中心与正/负离子中心: RDKit base feature definitions were used to identify hydrogen-bond donors/acceptors, aromatic rings, hydrophobic centres and positive/negative ionisable centres, and the number and geometric distribution of each feature were tabulated to assess whether the scaffold covers the key pharmacophore.
从母体识别羧酸、酯、芳环、甲基、羟基等可改造位点，生成四唑、酰胺、吡啶、氟代、三: Modifiable sites such as carboxylic acids, esters, aromatic rings, methyl and hydroxyl groups were identified in the parent molecule, and bioisosteric or scaffold-hopping candidates were generated, including tetrazole, amide, pyridine, fluoro, trifluoromethyl and phenolic hydroxyl replacements; the candidates were re-docked with the same receptor, binding box and scoring function, and ΔVina was reported and compared item by item with the parent.
以芳环/杂环为核心，枚举卤素、羟基、氨基、甲基、三氟甲基、甲氧基、氰基、酰胺、羧: With an aromatic or heteroaromatic ring as the core, substituents such as halogen, hydroxyl, amino, methyl, trifluoromethyl, methoxy, cyano, amide, carboxylic acid and sulfonamide were enumerated; molecules were pre-filtered with drug-likeness rules, and those passing the filter were subjected to docking and interaction analysis.
以 Morgan 指纹（半径 2，2048 bit）与本地 SMILES 数据库: Tanimoto similarity was computed between Morgan fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bit) and a local SMILES database, and the nearest neighbours were returned to assess whether the designed molecules fall within known chemical space.
所有图像由 Matplotlib 直接输出 PDF 矢量图，字体以 Type 4: All figures were exported directly from Matplotlib as vector PDFs with fonts embedded as Type 42; the palette uses a colour-blind-friendly deep teal/amber scheme; each figure occupies a single A4 page with its caption immediately below for continuous reading. The figures are labelled in Chinese; for submission to an English-language journal the labels can be re-typeset accordingly, without changing the data or coordinates.
Vina 打分为经验函数，忽略蛋白柔性与显式水；MM-GBSA 为近似分解；AD: Vina scores are empirical functions that ignore protein flexibility and explicit water; MM-GBSA is an approximate decomposition; ADMET endpoints are rule-based heuristic estimates; optimisation and design results are computational hypotheses that require molecular dynamics, free-energy perturbation or experimental validation. The random seed is recorded explicitly for each run, but a single run is insufficient to assess reproducibility; multiple seeds or repeated independent runs are needed before robustness can be claimed.
每个项目在磁盘上按 receptors/、ligands/、runs/ 与 ex: Each project is organised on disk into receptors/, ligands/, runs/ and exports/: the raw structures of receptors and ligands, cleaned PDB/PDBQT files, docking logs, and the PDBQT and score table for each pose are all traceable. Figures 1–6 in the report are generated directly from the results of the same run, and the appendix tables and the values in the text share the same data source, avoiding manual transcription errors.
PDBQT：AutoDock 系列使用的原子类型与电荷格式；LE：配体效率；Li: PDBQT: atom-type and charge format used by the AutoDock family; LE: ligand efficiency; LipE: lipophilic ligand efficiency; BEI: binding efficiency index; SEI: surface efficiency index; QED: quantitative estimate of drug-likeness; TPSA: topological polar surface area; MM-GBSA: molecular mechanics/generalised Born surface area method; HTS: high-throughput screening.
当受体结构中带有共晶配体时，程序自动以该配体为参照执行重对接：在同一结合盒与同一: When the receptor structure contains a co-crystal ligand, the program automatically performs redocking with that ligand as the reference: poses are regenerated with the same binding box and scoring function, heavy-atom RMSD is calculated with the symmetry-corrected algorithm in RDKit, and 2.0 Å is used as the pass criterion. This step tests whether receptor preparation, protonation and search parameters are appropriate; if it fails, the subsequent ranking can only be used to generate hypotheses. If the co-crystal ligand is a covalent inhibitor, Vina cannot form a covalent bond, and the validation must be repeated with a covalent docking program or with a non-covalent positive control.
在线数据模块与统一报告的组织方式: Organisation of the online data modules and the unified report
先用输入 SMILES 计算 InChIKey，在 ChEMBL 中做精确匹配；: The InChIKey of the input SMILES is first computed and matched exactly in ChEMBL; matched molecules are included directly in the summary. A Tanimoto similarity search is then performed with Morgan fingerprints (radius 2, 2048 bit): starting from the user-defined threshold, if fewer than 12–20 candidates are found, the threshold is lowered automatically in 10% steps down to 50%, up to 100 reference molecules are collected, and the results are cached locally. Deep mode further raises the reference-molecule limit to 40, doubles the reference-molecule budget, and increases the final target limit to 120 for network pharmacology analyses that require more nodes.
活性记录只把真实的定量值作为 pChEMBL：优先取数据库 pChEMBL，缺失: Only genuine quantitative values are treated as pChEMBL in activity records: the database pChEMBL is preferred, and when it is missing the value is converted from standard_value and standard_units; qualitative records without a quantitative value contribute only to the record count, and no pChEMBL of 5.0 or 7.0 is fabricated. Mechanism records are counted separately as mechanistic evidence. After retrieval, target details are retained for single proteins, protein complexes and protein families; all gene components of a complex enter the gene set, whereas cell-line and tissue targets are removed.
除 ChEMBL 外，还并行查询七类证据：BindingDB 的结构相似化合物活: In addition to ChEMBL, seven categories of evidence are queried in parallel: activities of structurally similar compounds in BindingDB (Tanimoto 0.85 → 0.70 → 0.60, with stepwise fallback), PubChem bioassay summaries, drug–gene relationships in DGIdb, mechanisms of action of approved drugs in Open Targets, co-crystal ligand matches in RCSB PDB (graph-exact, with fallback to graph-relaxed when human entries are insufficient), 2D/3D similarity-based target prediction from SwissTargetPrediction (including queue polling and session download), and a local FDA similar-drug fallback (Morgan-fingerprint Tanimoto ≥ 0.22). When all online services are unavailable, the local similar-drug fallback still provides a minimal target set instead of returning an empty result.
PDB 共晶与靶点名称会尝试映射到人源基因，非人源同源蛋白标记为 PDB hom: PDB co-crystals and target names are mapped to human genes where possible, and non-human homologous proteins are labelled PDB homolog; non-human entities that cannot be mapped retain a species label but do not enter the human network. Users can also paste an external gene list in the fishing panel; these genes are merged and de-duplicated under the Imported source. All sources are merged by gene or protein name and labelled with their source in the output; quantitative ChEMBL pChEMBL values and external evidence are reported separately, and external evidence without a pChEMBL is shown as “—” in the table. The method reflects the coverage of previously reported activities, drug annotations and structural data rather than de novo prediction: structurally novel molecules may yield only a few targets, and a negative result does not rule out a target.
网络药理学直接读取靶点垂钓得到的基因符号，提交 STRING（species 9: Network pharmacology reads the gene symbols obtained from target fishing directly and submits them to STRING (species 9606, required_score default 400) to build a protein–protein interaction network; when fewer than 12 seed genes are available, STRING can be asked to add first-order neighbours (add_nodes, default 15). Expanded nodes are coloured separately in the figure and serve only as network background; they are not counted as direct targets.
富集分析使用 Enrichr 的 8 个库：KEGG_2021_Human、GO: Enrichment analysis uses eight Enrichr libraries: KEGG_2021_Human, GO_Biological_Process_2023, GO_Cellular_Component_2023, GO_Molecular_Function_2023, Reactome_2022, WikiPathway_2023_Human, DisGeNET and MSigDB_Hallmark_2020; the top terms are reported by adjusted P value, with bubble area representing the number of genes and colour representing −log10(adjusted P).
在富集结果上进一步构建化合物–靶点–疾病（C-T-D）网络：疾病条目来自 Dis: A compound–target–disease (C-T-D) network is then built from the enrichment results: disease terms come from DisGeNET enrichment, and a gene–disease edge requires the gene to appear in the corresponding term; a gene–pathway Sankey diagram is also constructed, retaining only pathways hit by at least two input genes. If STRING returns no interaction edges, the enrichment, C-T-D and Sankey figures are retained and only the PPI network is skipped; if no library yields any term with FDR < 0.05, the report states that no significant term was detected instead of producing an empty enrichment figure.

Data sources: public FDA labels and DrugBank/PubChem/ChEMBL summaries; for reference only.

This module provides three things:

1. ``FDA_DRUGS``: 45 FDA-approved drugs with simple structures, defined SMILES and well-characterized targets, with fields covering drug class, HGNC target, indication, approval year, route of administration, typical half-life and CYP metabolizing enzymes. All SMILES are validated by RDKit parsing; half-life and approval year are filled in only when certain, otherwise ``None``.
2. ``compare``: compares a candidate molecule with the reference set one by one (Morgan fingerprint Tanimoto, Bemis–Murcko scaffold, maximum common substructure MCS, target Jaccard, ADMET and physicochemical property similarity) and returns a sortable reference list. No pIC50 values are fabricated; pharmacodynamic associations rely only on target overlap and mechanism proximity.
3. ``drugref_pdf``: A4 portrait CNS-style multi-panel figure (structural similarity bar chart, structure–target scatter, ADMET radar, property table, 2D structures of reference drugs) that can be included directly in the final report.

从母体识别羧酸、酯、酰胺、磺酰胺、芳环与末端甲基等可改造位点，按六个方向系统生成: Starting from the parent, carboxylic acids, esters, amides, sulfonamides, aromatic rings and terminal methyls are identified and six direction classes are enumerated: (i) bioisosteric replacement (carboxylic acid → tetrazole/acylsulfonamide/primary amide/hydroxamic acid, amide → nitrile, ester → amide/carboxylic acid, nitrile → tetrazole); (ii) scaffold hopping (benzene → pyridine/pyrimidine/pyridazine/pyrazine, mono-aza → diaza aromatic rings, five-membered S/O/N swaps, aza-fused rings); (iii) substituent walking (fluorine, chlorine, methyl, methoxy, hydroxyl, amino and cyano at multiple aromatic positions); (iv) metabolic blocking (amide/sulfonamide N-methylation, methyl → CF3); (v) linker modification (methylene → ether/amine/carbonyl); and (vi) second-generation combinations of top candidates. Candidates are filtered by a property prior and fingerprint diversity, then re-docked in the same receptor, box and scoring function; ΔVina, ligand efficiency and residue-level interactions are compared.
